note: CHAOS-3219 Phase 1 Lane 1b. legacy_agent is the only Ask Dev provider role with a working, production-representative certification probe today (llm.agent.role_readiness.RoleReadinessService.certify_role raises NotImplementedError for every other AgentRole member; see llm/agent/roles.py + llm/agent/probes/legacy_agent.py). This file is a representative, explicitly incomplete slice of the 134-case frozen registry (registry-ids.v1.json) -- it proves the per-case decision-sequence mechanism, the delegate-to-default mechanism, and all 6 fault types named in the CHAOS-3219 issue. Every case's 'question' is the EXACT literal text a corpus runner must send to address it -- routing is by a normalized hash of this text (provider_scripts.question_fingerprint), never a marker embedded in the question (see provider_scripts.py's module docstring for why). Phase 2 Lane 2b case authors add more entries here as they author tests/acceptance/world/ask-dev-world.v1/corpus/case-*.json, pinning each case's own real question text; an id present in registry-ids.v1.json but absent from this file's 'cases' is simply not addressable yet -- a question that doesn't match any entry here falls through to the untagged default heuristic exactly like any other ordinary question, so under-coverage never masks as false success (see registry-ids.v1.json cross-check conformance tests).
